classes.notes: Fast, fragile, cheap to field. No vehicle ships in this class yet, so the target is a placeholder and nothing is checked against it.
The Eclipse is the only medium, so the target is its budget by definition. It becomes a real constraint the moment a second medium is authored — which is exactly what D01-R27 is for.
The Stampede is the only heavy. Same caveat as medium: one vehicle per class means the check confirms arithmetic rather than balance until the roster grows.
